info.name: Siryan Hospital API
info.description:
Complete REST API collection for the Siryan Hospital Management System.

Base URL: http://localhost:5000/api

Authentication: Bearer token populated automatically after login via the collection-level pre-request script.

Folders: Auth, Patient, Doctor, Nurse, Receptionist, Pharmacist, Inventory, Lab, Radiology, Cashier, Admin, Notifications
